excerpt: Some of our most advanced current and future products are or will be either exclusively manufactured by TSMC or reliant upon critical components, including various compute die, manufactured by TSMC.
notes: Passage concerns Intel's products business using TSMC for compute die; buyer set to intel-products. Business section also says Intel expects to keep using TSMC and other third-party foundries; 10-K says it has no long-term contract with TSMC.
